description: Save a buy box as a new named filter in the user's RBSHome account so it appears on the RBSHome map. Creates a new saved filter only; never changes or deletes existing ones. Fails if the name is already used. Up to 20 saves per day.

filter.description: The buy box, with the same fields as filter_properties (a near circle is saved as its area)

attrs.description: Attribute filters keyed by registry key, e.g. {"flood_pct":{"max":5}} or {"flood_zone":{"not_in":["AE"]}}. Call list_filter_fields for the keys; never guess one.

counties.description: Dallas, Collin or both. Omit for both.

items.description: Dallas or Collin (Texas). No other county is covered.

exclude_keywords.description: Owner name contains none of these words

homestead.description: Property has a homestead exemption on the county tax roll: true = only these, false = leave these out, null = either

include_institutional.description: Include school districts, banks and hospitals. Default false.

include_keywords.description: Owner name contains any of these words

include_unmapped.description: Include leads with no map pin. Default false.

is_delinquent.description: Tax-delinquent: true = only these, false = leave these out, null = either

kinds.description: Property kinds from the tax roll

market_value_max.description: Highest appraisal-district market value, USD (not a price)

market_value_min.description: Lowest appraisal-district market value, USD (not a price)

min_score.description: Lowest lead score, 0 to 100. Default 45. Ignored while tiers is set, as on the map.

multiple_owners.description: More than one owner on title: true = only these, false = leave these out, null = either

near.description: Only leads within radius_mi of this property's map pin

lead_id.description: RBSHome property id, County:account, for example 'Collin:2771234' or 'Dallas:00000776655'

out_of_state_owner.description: Owner mailing address outside Texas: true = only these, false = leave these out, null = either

portfolio_min.description: Owner holds at least this many Dallas and Collin properties

property_use.description: Property use from the appraisal district

saved_filter_id.description: Start from this saved filter (ids from list_saved_filters); other fields change it

tiers.description: Lead tiers; A is the most distressed

years_owned_max.description: Most years the owner has held it

years_owned_min.description: Fewest years the owner has held it

name.description: Name shown on the RBSHome map, 1 to 80 characters

name: save_filter
title: Save a filter to RBSHome
